operations.command:
set -e
trap 'tail -60 /tmp/nixosctl-failed-install.log' ERR
cd /etc/nixos
# Discover the configured fixture so this also works in a native ARM run.
host=$(find config/hosts -path '*/VM-TEST/default.nix' -print -quit)
test -n "$host"
sed -i 's|settings.disk.device = "/dev/vda";|settings.disk.device = "/dev/nixosctl-missing-disk";|' "$host"
previous_hash=$(cat /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)
if printf 'testpass123\ntestpass123\n' | /run/nixosctl-under-test install --format --yes >/tmp/nixosctl-failed-install.log 2>&1; then
  echo 'expected disk preparation to fail'; exit 1
fi
test "$previous_hash" != "$(cat /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)"
grep -F /dev/nixosctl-missing-disk /tmp/nixosctl-failed-install.log >/dev/null
test ! -e /run/nixosctl-install/passphrase
sed -i 's|settings.disk.device = "/dev/nixosctl-missing-disk";|settings.disk.device = "/dev/vda";|' "$host"
printf failure-cleaned
set -e; install -d -m 755 /etc/nixos/secrets; printf fixture > /etc/nixos/secrets/permissions-fixture; chmod 644 /etc/nixos/secrets/permissions-fixture; printf source-permissions-ready

cd /etc/nixos && printf 'testpass123
testpass123
n
' | NIX_CONFIG='experimental-features = nix-command flakes' /run/nixosctl-under-test install --format --yes >/tmp/nixosctl-install.log 2>&1 && printf installed || { tail -60 /tmp/nixosctl-install.log; exit 1; }

set -e; test -f /mnt/etc/nixos/flake.nix; listing=$(btrfs subvolume list -a /mnt); for volume in @root @home; do echo "$listing" | grep -qE "@snapshots/$volume/CLEAN$" || { echo "no published CLEAN for $volume"; exit 1; }; [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "/mnt/.snapshots/$volume/CLEAN" ro 2>/dev/null)" = 'ro=true' ] || { echo "CLEAN for $volume is not read-only"; exit 1; }; done; if echo "$listing" | grep -qF 'CLEAN.tmp.'; then echo 'a CLEAN temporary was left behind'; exit 1; fi; printf clean-snapshots
set -e; script=/mnt/etc/nixos/tests/hosts-boot/unlock_and_wait.sh; test -x "$script" || { echo 'the permissions pass stripped an executable bit'; ls -l "$script"; exit 1; }; printf exec-bits-kept

set -e; test "$(stat -c %a /etc/nixos/secrets/permissions-fixture)" = 644; test "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a /mnt/etc/nixos/secrets)" = 0:0:700; test "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a /mnt/etc/nixos/secrets/permissions-fixture)" = 0:0:600; cmp /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash /mnt/var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash; test "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a /mnt/var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)" = 0:0:600; printf installed-secrets-protected
set -e; findmnt -rn --target /etc/nixos | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos' >/dev/null; test -f /etc/nixos/flake.nix; printf persisted-config

set -e; timeout 420 systemctl is-system-running --wait >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; state=$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true); failed=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | awk '{print $1}' | tr '\n' ' '); refused=$(journalctl -b -o cat 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'Service has no ExecStart' || true); echo "state=$state failed=$failed refused=$refused"; journalctl -b -o cat 2>/dev/null | grep 'Service has no ExecStart' || true; [ "$state" = running ] || exit 1; [ -z "$failed" ] || exit 1; [ "$refused" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; printf system-healthy
